segments.name: Smart Carts
segments.description: Develops and commercializes smart cart retail automation solutions, mainly for large grocery stores and supermarkets.
segments.evidence: a. Retail automation solutions – Smart Carts ("Smart Carts")

segments.name: Precision Metal Parts
segments.description: Manufactures and sells precision metal parts, supplying dozens of customers from the company's Israeli operations.
segments.evidence: b. Manufacturing and selling of precision metal parts – "Precision Metal Parts"

revenueModel.text: Supermarket chains, retailers and industrial customers pay for smart carts and precision metal parts, all sold in Israel.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenues from the smart cart segment are generated from one customer, and account for 41%, 10%, and 67% of the Company's revenues for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023.

changes.text: In 2025 the company sold its subsidiary Advanced Military Solutions, whose business is reported as discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: Effective June 30, 2025, we entered into a share purchase agreement pursuant to which we sold A2ZMS to a purchaser residing in Irael for a purchase price of 500,000 ILS.
